item.title: DC Water: Potomac Interceptor repairs halfway done, full restoration by mid-March expected
item.description: The repairs made to the Potomac Interceptor that resulted in the Jan. 19 sewer line collapse reached the halfway mark Friday, according to DC Water.

item.title: Prince George’s County reviewing more than 100 criminal cases over fingerprint analysis concerns
item.description: Leaders in Prince George’s County are reviewing more than 100 criminal cases after concerns were raised about fingerprint analysis conducted by a single forensic examiner.
